question: When configuring Service Catalog categories, which condition is mandatory for a category to be visible to users in the catalog?

choices.text: The category must be defined as a root category with no parent.
The category must contain at least one active item within its hierarchy.
The user must have the catalog_admin role to see the category.
The category must be associated with a specific Workflow to be published.

explanation: According to the documentation, if a category and its hierarchy contain no active items, the category does not appear in the catalog and cannot be added to it. Having at least one active item is therefore a prerequisite for it to display.
pieges: Believing that categories are visible as soon as they are created, even if empty.
Thinking that only administrators can see categories, when it is actually a matter of active content and availability settings.
Confusing visibility with roles (the admin or catalog_admin role is needed for configuration, but visibility is governed by the presence of active items).
